findings.summary: Include crypto in the non-COI required checks. SDK boot unconditionally calls crypto.randomUUID at packages/rifty/src/sandbox.ts:393, but only the COI list contains crypto. Thus an observed mandatory failure is classified as incomplete for non-COI and its proven cause is omitted from that mode's reasons. Fault class: sibling-drift between actual SDK requirements and the report projection. Missing RED: existing UUID carrier tests only COI; add non-COI failed conclusion and reason. Sibling sweep: COI already requires UUID; both modes share module/eval and selected OPFS requirements, with VM/WASM/SW differences checked against actual paths.
